scoring_justification: The paper reports qualitative trends (monotonicity, ordering, NDR) without numerical tables; structural checks directly verify these claims. Full recompute is infeasible due to absent numeric gold.

units.V: dimensionless (units of k_B T per lattice spacing)
units.occupancy: fraction (average number of protons per site)

outputs.description: Simulation results for multiple parameter regimes. Each row corresponds to a single simulation point (condition and voltage).

output_contract.notes: The checker will verify qualitative structural trends: monotonic non-decreasing J(V) except for NDR conditions where a peak must be present; relative ordering of currents across parameter variations (e.g., higher k0 yields higher J, higher H yields lower J, R>0 curves more convex than R=0, and lubrication enhancement at high injection rates). Occupancy should decrease with H and increase with injection.

steps.checks_description: Verify required rows, voltage sweep, monotonicity, relative ordering, and occupancy trends as described.
